title: Search Lean declarations for an unknown name or a goal
when: the harness has a check with an unknown identifier or constant and looks for the declarations the name was meant to be
the harness has a hole's goal and looks for the lemmas that fit it
whenNot: checking that a name exists in the run's environment: that is a Lean call, which the harness makes on every hit
proving anything: a hit is a name, and only a Lean proof settles a claim
a call from the model: the model never calls it, the harness pushes verified hits into the check's answer

query.description: A declaration name that Lean does not know (kind name), or the text of a goal (kind goal)

private.description: True: the run sends nothing to a third party, so the backends that would are not asked

name.description: A declaration name, as a backend gave it: unverified

used.description: The backends that were asked and answered

skipped.description: The backends that were not asked (a private run) or that failed, with why

thirdParty.sends: the unknown name, or the text of a goal, to a search service

examples.title: a name that Lean does not know
examples.note: The names are the backends'; the harness checks each with Lean before it shows one.

skipped.reason: private run: nothing leaves for a third party

implementations.description: The three backends the host profile sets up, asked together and merged: remote (remoteUrl, https, no redirect, a cap on the answer, a time limit), pattern (patternUrl, a Loogle-like service, or the local index) and local (index, a file of declarations, BM25). Not run against a real service or a Mathlib-sized index.

environment.remoteUrl: the address LEAN_SEARCH_URL gives; in the local profile https://leansearch.net/search when it is not set
environment.remoteQuery: text or list, as LEAN_SEARCH_QUERY gives; list in the local profile (leansearch.net reads only that form)
environment.patternUrl: the address LEAN_PATTERN_URL gives; in the local profile https://loogle.lean-lang.org/json when it is not set
environment.index: the file LEAN_SEARCH_INDEX names, or none
